shots.name: window
shots.alt: The battuta window: header with tabs, the score as measure tiles flowed into rows, and the status bar. Schumann's Melodie is open with the caret on its first note.

shots.name: header
shots.alt: The header: the tab strip (the active tab carries the unsaved-changes star), new-tab button, open, view toggle, measure buttons, save, title, and the id-repair and shortcut-editor buttons.

shots.name: statusbar
shots.alt: The status bar: the INPUT indicator and caret readout on the left; staves, voices, harmony, clef, key, meter, zoom and MIDI on the right.

shots.name: statusbar-input
shots.alt: Input mode on: the indicator turns green and reads the duration about to be written — here a quarter note on the 5 key — beside the caret readout.

shots.name: zoom-panel
shots.alt: The zoom panel over its status-bar button: minus, plus and reset, from 50% to 250% in 25% steps.

shots.name: selection-run
shots.alt: An event run selected in red: shift-click from the caret, or shift+arrows, along one voice.

shots.name: selection-block
shots.alt: A block selection in green: a rectangle of measures × staves, painted by dragging.

shots.name: toast
shots.alt: A toast in the bottom-right corner confirming a copy; the × dismisses it early and the text can be selected.

shots.name: shortcut-editor
shots.alt: The shortcut editor: every action grouped with its current keys, the QWERTY/AZERTY layout toggle, and rebinding by clicking a key and pressing a new one.

shots.name: page-view
shots.alt: Page view: the whole document through Verovio's page layout, with the printed title — and the player controls in the header.

shots.name: player
shots.alt: The player while playing: pause and stop, the live tempo select, the clickable progress bar and the elapsed/total readout.

shots.name: player-highlight
shots.alt: The note being sounded lights up as the score plays — audio and highlight come from the same timeline.
